reviews.title: Subscription thirsty
reviews.text: I can’t use the damn thing without first subscribing? Hell no. I don’t trust your app. If I see that it works, does its job well, great features, very intuitive and convenient, then I’ll consider giving my money. Again, I do t trust any darn app to not scam me in some way. I’m no tech wizard so I err on caution. Not for free, not for me.
